name: 3rd Grade Mathematics
description: Eight instructional units following the linked Grade 3 Mathematics Scope & Sequence, with source-aligned learning targets, standards, and guiding questions.

source.title: 3rd Grade Mathematics Scope & Sequence
source.note: The PDF gives eight units with broad standards/outcomes and guiding questions, not numbered lesson titles. The skills are concise editorial subdivisions and retain the source's instructional sequence.

standards.3.OA.1: Interpret products of whole numbers as equal groups.
standards.3.OA.2: Interpret whole-number quotients as equal sharing or grouping.
standards.3.OA.3: Solve multiplication and division word problems within 100 using equal groups, arrays, and measurement situations.
standards.3.OA.4: Find the unknown whole number in multiplication and division equations.
standards.3.OA.5: Apply operation properties to multiplication and division.
standards.3.OA.6: Understand division as an unknown-factor problem.
standards.3.OA.8: Solve two-step word problems with the four operations; represent unknowns and check reasonableness.
standards.3.OA.9: Identify and explain arithmetic patterns using operation properties.
standards.3.NBT.1: Round whole numbers to the nearest 10 or 100.
standards.3.NBT.2: Fluently add and subtract within 1000 using place-value and operation strategies.
standards.3.NBT.3: Multiply one-digit whole numbers by multiples of ten from 10–90.
standards.3.NF.1: Understand unit fractions and fractions formed by equal parts.
standards.3.NF.2: Understand and represent fractions as numbers on a number line.
standards.3.NF.3: Explain simple fraction equivalence and compare fractions by size.
standards.3.MD.1: Tell and write time to the nearest minute and solve elapsed-time problems.
standards.3.MD.2: Measure mass and liquid volume in standard units and solve related word problems.
standards.3.MD.3: Draw scaled picture and bar graphs and solve comparison problems.
standards.3.MD.4: Measure length in halves and fourths of an inch and represent measurements on line plots.
standards.3.MD.5: Understand area as unit squares covering a plane figure.
standards.3.MD.6: Measure area by counting unit squares.
standards.3.MD.7: Relate area to multiplication and addition; decompose rectangles.
standards.3.MD.8: Solve perimeter problems including unknown sides and same-area/perimeter comparisons.
standards.3.G.1: Classify two-dimensional shapes based on shared attributes.
standards.3.G.2: Partition shapes into equal-area parts and name their unit fractions.
standards.2.G.2: Partition rectangles into rows and columns of same-size squares and count squares.
